{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the revenue column has commas in some rows
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check the actual values that have commas
comma_rows = df[has_commas]
print("\nValues with commas:")
print(comma_rows['revenue'].unique())

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
# But only if there are actually commas to remove
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Show the first few QA orders
print("\nFirst few QA orders:")
print(qa_orders.head())"}
